# 1) Read in File and Make Plotting Function ====
This section of the code reads in the file and makes the function that makes the plots.
```{r}
#Set plot directories
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#Set results file
results_file="C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/genotype_beta_correlation_deviation_metrics.csv"
#Read in the results file
input_df <- read.csv(results_file)
#Set factors for buckets
input_df$bucket_range <- factor(input_df$bucket_range, levels = c("0.0-1.0","0.0-0.2","0.2-0.4","0.4-0.6","0.6-0.8","0.8-1.0","0.0-0.1","0.1-0.2", "0.2-0.3", "0.3-0.4","0.4-0.5"))

#Set function
plot_simulation_results <- function(inp_df, 
                                   x_var, 
                                   y_var, 
                                   color_var = NULL,
                                   filter_bucket = "overall",
                                   filter_trait_type = NULL,
                                   filter_n_causal = NULL,
                                   facet_var = NULL, plot_title=NULL) {
  # Read results data
  df <- inp_df
  
  if(!is.null(filter_bucket)){
    df <- df %>% filter(bucket_type %in% filter_bucket)
  }
  # Apply optional filters
  if (!is.null(filter_trait_type)) {
    df <- df %>% filter(trait_type %in% filter_trait_type)
  }
  if (!is.null(filter_n_causal)) {
    df <- df %>% filter(n_causal %in% filter_n_causal)
  }
  
  # Create base plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var, color = color_var)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = gsub("_", " ", toupper(x_var)),
      y = gsub("_", " ", toupper(y_var))
    )
  
  # Faceting
  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)), scales = "free_x")
  }
  
  # Handle numeric vs categorical x-variables
  if (is.numeric(df[[x_var]])) {
    p <- p + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma)
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  }
  
  print(p)
}

```
# 2) Make basic plot of continuous traits ====
```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="n_traits", y_var="mae", color_var="n_causal", filter_bucket = "overall", filter_trait_type = "continuous", 
                        plot_title="Continuous Traits", facet_var="population")

```
# 3) Make Basic Plot of Binary Traits Colored by Case Proportion====
```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="n_traits", y_var="mae", color_var="case_prob", filter_bucket = "overall", filter_trait_type = "binary", 
                        plot_title="Binary Traits", facet_var="population")

```
# 4) Make Plot of All Simulations with 0 Causal Variants ====
```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="n_traits", y_var="mae", color_var="trait_type", filter_bucket = "overall", filter_n_causal = 0, 
                        plot_title="Continuous and Binary Traits with 0 Causal Variants", facet_var="population")

```
# 5) Make Plot of All Traits with 0 Causal variants and Binary Traits limited to Variant Pairs for which all betas were calculable ====
```{r}
#Filter for overall rows where beta correlations are based off of all simulated traits (there were no calculation errors)
full_calc_df <-input_df %>% filter((trait_type == "continuous" & bucket_type=="overall") | (trait_type == "binary" & bucket_type=="overall_filtered"))
plot_simulation_results(full_calc_df, x_var="n_traits", y_var="mae", color_var="trait_type", filter_n_causal=0,
                        plot_title="No Causality Continuous and Binary Traits of Full-Trait Variant Pairs", facet_var="population", filter_bucket = NULL)

```
# 6) Make Plot of Genotype Correlation Buckets ====
```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="bucket_range", y_var="mae", color_var="n_traits", filter_bucket = "geno_corr", filter_trait_type = "continuous", 
                        plot_title="Continuous Traits with 0 Causal Variants Split by Genotype Correlation", filter_n_causal = 0, facet_var="population")

```

```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="bucket_range", y_var="mae", color_var="n_traits", filter_bucket = "maf", filter_trait_type = "continuous",

```

```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="n_traits", y_var="mae", color_var="effect_size", filter_bucket = "overall", filter_trait_type = "binary",
```

```{r}

plot_simulation_results(input_df, x_var="n_traits", y_var="mae", color_var="n_causal", filter_bucket = "overall", filter_trait_type = "binary",
```

# 10) Make Table of Continuous Trait Standard Errors ====
```{r}
#Set output file location
out_file <- "C:/Users/mconery/Box/Mitchell_Work_Files/Meta-Analysis_Fine-Mapping/Data/1000G_Simulations/correlation_error_standard_deviations.csv"
#Filter and write file
input_df %>% filter(trait_type == "continuous" & bucket_type == "geno_corr") %>% group_by(n_traits, bucket_range) %>% summarize(stddev_error=mean(stddev_error, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% write.csv(file=out_file, col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = ",")
```
